newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Close Mobutu ally appointed to head Zaire army.
newsitem.headline: Close Mobutu ally appointed to head Zaire army.

text.p: The Commander of Zaire's civil guard, General Kpama Baramoto Kata, will take over as interim chief of staff of the Central African country's army, state radio reported on Thursday.
Baramoto, a close ally of ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko, had been named by the defence minister, it said.

He replaces General Eluki Monga who was suspended on Wednesday following declarations he made on French radio contradicting the government's position favouring the deployment of a multinational force in Zaire to help war refugees.
Eluki told French radio on Tuesday that the intervention of a U.N. force in Zaire was now unnecessary after the exodus home of nearly half a million Rwandan refugees.

A government official said Eluki also repeated complaints by the army that the government was not giving the military the means to battle Rwandan-backed Tutsi rebels who have seized much of Zaire's two eastern provinces.
The Zaire government maintains that a multinational force is still needed to help hundreds of thousands of other refugees and Zairean villagers displaced by fighting since October 18.
